personality_one_liner: A culinary magazine brought to life with elegant serif headers and highly readable sans-serif body text, prioritizing ingredient focus and fast hands-free interactions.

spacing.rule: Magazine-like spacing with generous vertical breathing room. Minimal side padding for full-bleed hero images, generous padding for text. Keep UI chrome quiet.

dont's: Editorial personality relies on clean lines, whitespace, and solid surfaces. Avoid glassmorphism to maintain the high-end print magazine feel.

screens.name: Auth / Role Select
screens.purpose: Seamless entry point where users login and select their culinary persona (Home Cook or Chef).

states.loading: Centered minimalist spinner with 'Preparing your kitchen...' text.
states.error: Clean inline error message above the submit button.

screens.layout: Full-bleed background image with a gradient scrim. Large Lora heading. Large tappable role cards for 'Home Cook' vs 'Chef' using brandTertiary backgrounds when selected. Bottom sticky login CTA.

screens.name: Home / Search
screens.purpose: Fast, input-first screen to enter ingredients or dishes and request pairings.

states.loading: Shimmering skeletons for recent searches and category chips.
states.empty: Illustration/Photo of ingredients with prompt 'What are you cooking today?'.
states.error: Error toast using surfaceInverse for high contrast.

screens.layout: Large editorial typography for the search prompt. Oversized, borderless text input. Horizontal scrolling chips for 'Ingredient', 'Dish', 'Beverage' filters. A prominent sticky CTA 'Find Pairing' anchored at the bottom.

screens.name: Pairing Results
screens.purpose: Displays AI-generated pairing recommendations, explanations, and mini-recipes.

states.loading: Skeleton cards mimicking the layout of pairing results with a subtle pulsing animation.
states.empty: Empty state illustration with text 'No pairings found for this combination. Try another ingredient!'
states.error: Retry button centered on screen with 'We couldn't fetch pairings right now.' text.

screens.layout: Editorial magazine layout: large Lora title for the queried item. Pairing results presented as clean, full-width cards with a subtle divider instead of shadows. Each card includes a badge (brandTertiary), reasoning text (Plus Jakarta Sans), and an expandable mini-recipe section. WhatsApp share button as a subtle icon action.

screens.name: Saved Favorites
screens.purpose: Archive of the user's best pairings and discovered combinations.

states.empty: Empty state photo (wine & cheese) with 'Your culinary archive is empty. Start saving your favorite pairings.'

screens.layout: Simple list layout with generous vertical spacing (xl) between items. Leading visual (initials or category icon), title in Lora, and short description in Sans-serif. 'View Recipe' secondary button.

screens.name: Chef Mode Menu Builder
screens.purpose: Batch pairing and menu generation tool specifically styled for professionals.

states.loading: Spinner with 'Generating professional menu pairings...' text.
states.empty: Professional chef plating photo with 'Start building your next menu.'

screens.layout: Denser, utility-infused editorial layout. Section headers for Course 1, Course 2, etc. Inline inputs for quick ingredient addition. Use surfaceTertiary blocks for grouped items to maintain structure without relying on borders.

screens.name: Premium Paywall
screens.purpose: Upsell screen when the user hits the 5 pairings/day limit.
screens.layout: Cinematic full-bleed image background (wine/cheese or chef plating) with a heavy gradient-to-dark scrim. 'Unlock Limitless Pairings' Lora headline. A bulleted list of pro features. Large sticky brandPrimary CTA at the bottom for PayPal.

texture_bg.alt: Textured paper background for warm organic feel

empty_state_food.alt: Fresh ingredients on a cutting board top view

pairing_wine_cheese.alt: Wine and cheese pairing top down

instructions_to_main_agent: Use Editorial structure: Lora for headings (dish names, pairing recommendations) to evoke a premium cookbook feel, and Plus Jakarta Sans for UI elements, labels, and explanations to ensure clarity.
Do not use Indigo, Violet, or Blues anywhere in the app. Strict ban. Stick to the terracotta, sand, and charcoal palette to represent food and warmth.

Implement the MANDATORY gradient-to-dark scrim pattern whenever text is placed on top of images (e.g., hero banners on the Paywall or Auth screens). Ensure the bottom stop opacity is at least 70% surfaceInverse.
The AI Search input screen should feel fast and distraction-free. Avoid dense dashboards; utilize heavy whitespace and generous vertical padding (xl, 2xl).
Ensure every screen implements the specified Loading, Empty, and Error states. Empty states should utilize the provided high-quality food photography, not just generic icons.
Keep the primary CTAs (e.g., 'Find Pairing', 'Unlock Premium') sticky at the bottom with safe-area padding so the user doesn't have to scroll to act.
Use 'Feather' icons exclusively, ensuring consistent weight. Tinted icon containers (using brandTertiary) are preferred over floating bare icons.
